chos mngon pa'i btus pa ni | byams pa | thogs med | dbyig gnyen | blo brtan | gang pa spel | kha che 'ji na mi tra | de la  .og | kru gu'i rgyal mtshan dang | zhang snad snad snad pa ye shes sde | rgyal ba ye shes | gru mchog gi ye shes + se btsun gzhon nu dbang phyug | gar mi yon tan g.yung drung | khu lha sdids pa b.on 'grus gyung drung | 'gra rgyal bu tshul le | brang ti dar ma snying po | 'ban dkon mchog rdo rje | tho skun  dga' rdo rde | byang chub skyabs | gzhon byang | 'bring tshams zhang | rin dbe | .g sde sed rgyal | dpang lo tsha ba chen po dpal ldan gros brtan pa'o ||
